audit.why: Exactly 50.00% over 2036 games with Lucian owning levels 1-3 and Rumble owning 4 onward matches the kit maths: Lucian's early edge is Lightslinger short-trading at range, and Rumble's takeover is chained Danger Zone cones once heat cycling is clean. EVEN at 6/10 stands.

audit.whatIsWrong: The two layers disagree on the first item: the content layer names 'Shadowflame or Luden's' in whys[5] and spikes[3], the full layer names Liandry's Torment everywhere.
audit.why: A player reading the page gets two different first items for the same matchup. Liandry's is what the rest of Rumble's data uses and it is the one that matches Flamespitter's sustained burn.
audit.corrected: Aligned the content layer to Liandry's Torment.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three interactions absent. (a) Relentless Pursuit is 16/15.5/15/14.5/14s — far longer than the page implies — BUT Lightslinger attacks reduce its cooldown, so 'trade when his E is down' is only true if you also deny him the hits that refund it. Nothing said this. (b) Piercing Light fires THROUGH a target, so Lucian casts it on a minion and the bolt still reaches you: standing behind the wave is not cover. Absent. (c) Ardent Blaze marks you and gives him move speed for attacking a marked target — the mark is the commit tell. Absent.
audit.why: Riot text — Relentless Pursuit: 'Lightslinger attacks reduce Relentless Pursuit's cooldown.' Piercing Light: 'Lucian shoots a bolt of piercing light through a target.' Ardent Blaze: 'marking and briefly revealing enemies. Lucian gains Move Speed for attacking marked enemies.'
audit.corrected: All three written in, with the real numbers, and the trading rule reframed as 'deny the shots and the dash stays down'.

audit.corrected: Listed Relentless Pursuit 16/15.5/15/14.5/14s with the Lightslinger refund, Piercing Light 9-5s, The Culling 110s at 1400 range.

audit.whatIsWrong: _missing-interactions.json asserts 'Lucian sustains through chip damage (Lightslinger (P)) — Grievous Wounds timing decides extended trades', which would put anti-heal in the build.
audit.why: Lightslinger has no self-heal. Riot's text says his shots are empowered when Lucian is healed or shielded BY AN ALLY — the kit-file 'heal' flag parsed that clause. In a solo lane against Rumble there is no ally shield and no immobilise, so his passive is simply the double-shot. Building Grievous Wounds here would be wasted gold.
audit.corrected: No anti-heal added; the itemization line was left untouched.

edits.before: At Level 1 Lucian simply walks up and double-shots you between Flamespitter cones — his passive means every ability proc gifts him a free auto, and you cannot match that output without Danger Zone heat you do not have yet. Hold Flamespitter until he steps in rather than channeling into air, and accept that the first two levels belong to his range advantage. At Level 2 you pick up Electro-Harpoon, which changes the exchange — hit the first Harpoon to stop his Relentless Pursuit dash before you commit Flamespitter, and he cannot cleanly reset the trade. By Level 3 you can chain Q into double-E into W shield and force him to respect Overheat-empowered autos if he lingers, but his dash still bails him out if you do not land the slow first. Keep the wave near your tower so he cannot freely auto you under no risk — the closer the minions, the shorter the gap he must cross.
edits.after: At level 1 Lucian walks up and double-shots you between Flamespitter cones — Lightslinger turns every ability he casts into a free extra shot, and you cannot match that without Danger Zone heat you do not have yet. Hold the cone until he steps in rather than burning it into air, and accept that the first two levels are his. Watch Piercing Light: it fires THROUGH a target, so he can cast it on the caster minion and the bolt still reaches you — standing behind the wave is not cover. At 2 you get Electro Harpoon and the exchange changes: land the first harpoon to slow him before you commit the cone, because Relentless Pursuit is 16 seconds at rank 1 and he will not want to spend it. By 3 you can chain the cone into both harpoons into Scrap Shield and make him respect you, but the dash still bails him out if the slow misses. Keep the wave near your tower so the gap he has to cross stays short.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 are your takeover window. Experienced Heat cycling — letting Q drop back to ~50 between cones rather than spiking to 100 accidentally — means you can run two full Danger Zone trades back-to-back, and Lucian has no answer to sustained empowered Flamespitter if Relentless Pursuit is on cooldown. Track its cooldown like a resource: the moment it is down, step in with Harpoon, channel Q into his face, and use W shield to eat his passive-proc autos. At Level 6 The Equalizer rewrites the dynamic entirely — you no longer need to win the 1v1 cleanly. Drop it perpendicular to his escape route after a Harpoon slow, and the burn damage plus AoE slow forces a kill or burns his Flash. Even the threat of a placed Equalizer means he cannot freely push the wave and recall, giving you permanent pressure on the wave state.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 are your takeover window. Cycle heat deliberately — let it fall back toward 50 between cones instead of spiking to 100 by accident — and you can run two full Danger Zone trades back to back, which Lucian has no answer to while Relentless Pursuit is down. Track it honestly though: the dash is 16 seconds at rank 1 and 14 at rank 5, and every Lightslinger shot he lands cuts that number down, so a Lucian who is hitting you gets his escape back early. Deny the autos and you deny the dash. The moment it is genuinely down, harpoon, walk the cone into his face, and let Scrap Shield eat the return shots. At 6 The Equalizer rewrites the lane — you no longer have to win the 1v1. Lay it perpendicular to his retreat after a harpoon slow and the burn plus slow forces a kill or a Flash. Even the threat stops him pushing and recalling freely.

edits.before: Your teamfight ultimate is your real edge late — a well-placed Equalizer on a chokepoint wins a dragon or Baron fight without you needing to 1v1 anyone. In the side lane Lucian still has enough kite and double-shot burst to punish an isolated Rumble without jungle backup, so avoid extended 1v1s when his items are ahead. Play around your Harpoon cooldown: if both casts are up you have real kill pressure with Equalizer following; if they are down, respect his range and back off. The lane itself is settled by this point — your job is global presence, so Equalizer sniping retreats through Teleport lanes and grouping for mid-game fights where your sustained Danger Zone damage and AoE burn outperform his single-target output.
edits.after: Your ultimate is the real edge late — The Equalizer on a chokepoint wins a dragon or Baron fight without you duelling anyone, at 1750 range and 80 seconds at rank 3. In the side lane Lucian still has the kite and double-shot burst to punish an isolated Rumble, so refuse extended 1v1s when his items are ahead. Play around your harpoon charges: two up means real kill pressure with Equalizer behind it; both spent means respect his range and leave. Watch for Ardent Blaze — if it marks you he gains move speed for attacking you, and that mark is the tell that he is committing rather than poking. The lane itself is settled by now; your job is global presence and grouping for fights where sustained burn beats single-target output.

notes: Deliberately NOT written: _missing-interactions.json tells this matchup "Lucian sustains through chip damage (Lightslinger (P)) — Grievous Wounds timing decides extended trades." Lucian has no self-heal. Riot's Lightslinger text says his shots are empowered "when Lucian is healed or shielded by an ally, or when a nearby enemy Champion is immobilized" — the kit file's "heal" and "shield" flags parsed that clause. Against a solo-lane Rumble there is no ally shield and Rumble has no immobilise (Electro Harpoon slows, it does not root), so Lucian's passive here is purely the post-ability double-shot. Building Grievous Wounds into this matchup would be wasted gold and I did not add it. Build inconsistency fixed: the content layer named "Shadowflame or Luden's" as the first item while the full layer names Liandry's Torment in phases[5].why and report[8].t; I aligned content to Liandry's, but flagging it because I am inferring which layer is right from consistency across the rest of Rumble's data rather than from a build source. Biggest genuine addition: Relentless Pursuit is 16/15.5/15/14.5/14s AND "Lightslinger attacks reduce Relentless Pursuit's cooldown" — the whole "trade when his E is down" plan is only true if you also deny him the autos that refund it. Also added that Piercing Light fires through a target, so casting it on a minion still hits you and hiding behind the wave is not cover. Rumble's Scrap Shield "knockup"/"terrain" flags and The Equalizer's "terrain" flag remain misfires and are not asserted here.
